newsitem.title: GREECE: Bank of Greece to keep anti-inflation stance in 97.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Greece to keep anti-inflation stance in 97.

text.p: Greece's central bank will maintain its anti-inflationary stance in 1997, targeting ecu/drachma stability, said governor Lucas Papademos during a monetary and forex policy address.
He said the central bank's main goal will be to drive Greece's inflation down to 4.5 percent by year end and to below 3.0 percent by year-end 1998.

Foreign exchange policy will also stay anti-inflationary but show greater flexibility this year. The Bank of Greece will take into account inflationary pressures and prevailing conditions in the money and forex markets, he said.
